722710101.text: Welcome to my humble shop! We have some new items in store, if you would be so kind as to take a look at them.

722710102.text: I've got some treasure I want to sell.

722710103.text: Oh, what rare objects have you found this time? Let me have a look.

722710104.text: You tell Linlang about the Dragonbone Orb.

722710105.text: If what you see is true, this is a truly amazing relic.

722710106.text: But from a cursory examination, I can't find anything evidently special about it. Perhaps it requires extensive use to show its qualities...

722710107.text: The way I see it, it does seem that the wondrous properties you ascribe to it might be a tad... exaggerated. Perhaps it was simply something entrusted to you by those who had failed in their task.

722710108.text: Don't take it to heart, though. I'm just saying what's coming to my mind.

722710122.text: This is quite the common occurrence in our line of work, anyway.

722710109.text: Also, I believe that you did not keep this in sealed storage — it does seem like there is some wear and tear on its surface already.

722710110.text: I'm afraid that there will be some price reduction on that front, too.

722710123.text: How does 80,000 Mora sound? I can add 5 Bountiful Years on as specialty dishes as well.

722710111.text: I believe that this is a good price.

722710113.text: To be honest, I would consider the story behind it more valuable than its capabilities.

722710114.text: I suspect that this might be of much interest to our storytellers and opera troupes, or perhaps the great men and women of Yujing Terrace.

722710115.text: It would be quite the ancient showpiece of a relic even if I were to simply mount it on our shop counter.

722710117.text: My, that's quite forward of you. Well then, here's you Mora.

722710118.text: If you should find any other such treasures, we are always awaiting your patronage.

722710120.text: No problem. After all, you should always check the goods — I mean, the prices — when you're planning to sell precious relics.

722710121.text: You can come to me again once you've mulled the matter over.

722710202.text: Oh, have you considered your options?

722710203.text: I'll take that item for 80,000 Mora and 5 Bountiful Years.

722710205.text: Thank you for your patronage. Here's your Mora.

722710206.text: If you should find any other such treasures, we are always awaiting your patronage.

722710208.text: No problem. After all, you should always check the prices on the market when you're planning to sell precious relics.

722710209.text: You can come to me again once you've mulled the matter over.
